product_name: 便携式无人机察打一体设备
summary: 便携式无人机察打一体设备集侦测、跟踪、定位、反制、联网功能于一体，单设备即可实现无人机管控全流程工作；系统续航充足、重量轻、加固设计，非常适合背负/手持。 设备通过无线电频率扫描无人机频谱特征，解析Drone ID和Remote ID报文，侦测非法入侵的无人机，能够识别无人机与遥控器之间的控制信号、图传信号；并通过电磁压制技术，实现对无人机遥控链路、图传链路和导航信号的干扰阻断，迫使无人机返航或降落。
summary_en: The Integrated Detection & Jamming C-UAS combines detection, tracking, positioning, neutralization, and networking functions into one unit, enabling a complete drone control workflow. The system features long battery life, lightweight design, and rugged construction, making it ideal for backpack or handheld use. It scans frequencies for spectral signatures and parses Drone ID and Remote ID messages to detect unauthorized drones. By identifying control and video links and applying electromagnetic suppression, it blocks remote control and navigation signals, forcing drones to land or return.
key_application: 应用领域：设备通过无线电频率扫描无人机频谱特征，解析Drone ID和Remote ID报文，侦测非法入侵的无人机，能够识别无人机与遥控器之间的控制信号、图传信号；并通过电磁压制技术，实现对无人机遥控链路、图传链路和导航信号的干扰阻断，迫使无人机返航或降落。；探测与打击一体化设计，高度集成，单台设备即可完成无人机的探测和打击。；探测机型全
key_application_en: Integrated detection and strike design for high-portability operations; parses Drone ID and Remote ID for precision identification; 2km effective jamming range; supports single-target precision strike among drone swarms.
key_parameter_1: 最大有效干扰距离: ≥2km（通视条件）

parameters.侦测模式: 能够提供全向探测和定向测向两种模式
parameters.工作时间: 侦测待机时间≥1.5h反制连续不间断工作时间≥15min
parameters.联网方式: 能够接入统一的无人机平台

parameters_en.Detection Mode: Provides both omni-directional and directional modes
parameters_en.Algorithm Support: Spectrum fingerprinting, Drone ID, Remote ID

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 单机集成：全流程侦测预警、报文解析、精确定位与反制打击，无需配件。
  • 探测机型多：兼容消费级、工业级及DIY改装无人机，极高识别准确率。
  • 精准打击：核心技术支持对大疆等主流型号在群航中实现精准单体打击。
  • 无源侦测：基于频谱扫描与ID解析，隐蔽性极高，不产生电磁暴露。
  • 多种模式：灵活选择驱离、迫降或悬停应对不同威胁程度。
  • Figure 1 Integrated Detection & Jamming C-UAS
detail_html_en:
Features

  • Consolidated C-UAS tool: completes the full detection-to-neutralization lifecycle on a single portable device.
  • Drone ID & Remote ID parsing: utilizes message decoding for precise identification of mainstream drone brands.
  • Precision strike capability: enables single-target neutralization within a swarm for certain DJI models without affecting surroundings.
  • Passive monitoring: high-stealth operation based on spectral fingerprinting without signal emission.
  • Ergonomic design: 6.5kg lightweight shield structure with swappable batteries for field mobility.
